overview_description.description:
Tired of having to track all your items, sales and messages on multiple marketplaces? Sick of manually entering the same information on every post? Vendoo is here to help! We make your selling experience quick, easy and more effective!

You no longer have to go to from one site to another to post. Vendoo allows you to fill out the details once and post that item to the marketplaces of your choice with ease.

All of your item listings, messages and sales from each marketplace are clearly displayed in one place.

We provide you with useful information to help you know your business better. The information includes your sales and customer interactions from each marketplace and your best selling items, which help you understand which marketplace works the best for you.

about_short_description.short_description: Vendoo allows you to easily list items on multiple marketplaces. We help you sell more items, save time and learn about your business.

product.name: Vendoo Crosslisting Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that enables resellers to list, manage, and crosspost inventory across 10+ online marketplaces from a single dashboard.

product.name: Bulk Actions Tool
product.description: A feature that allows users to perform bulk listing, editing, delisting, relisting, copying, and labeling of up to 240 items simultaneously across multiple marketplaces.

product.name: Sale Detection and Auto Delisting
product.description: An automated system that detects when an item sells on one marketplace and removes it from all other connected marketplaces to prevent double-selling.

product.name: Multi-Quantity Listing Management
product.description: A tool that allows resellers to list and manage multiple quantities of the same item across supported marketplaces from a centralized interface.

product.name: Inventory Management System
product.description: A centralized dashboard for managing, organizing, and tracking inventory across multiple marketplaces with tools like custom labels, listing templates, and downloadable spreadsheets.

product.name: Marketplace Sharing Add-On
product.description: An add-on feature that automates sharing, refreshing, and bumping of listings on Poshmark, Depop, and Grailed to increase item visibility and sales.
